purpose: Defines the review policy requirements for forge: document-centered review priorities, review as observations not instructions, CLI axes, confidence-based auto-fix, backends, and finding verification.
summary: Background and philosophy: review purified into document matching, with complete information available at design time
Review position: findings are observations, and the main body decides adoption; severity does not decide adoption
FNC-1301/1302/1309: priorities P1 rule match, P2 contradiction, P3 unnecessary complexity; criteria hold no judgment and a fixed 3-section structure
FNC-1303/1312/1310: target axes diff, branch, files, dirs; granularity preserved; CLI structure without positional arguments
FNC-1304: interaction axes interactive and auto; confidence marks decide auto-fix, not severity
FNC-1313/1319/1320: focus, scope, and project rules or specs passed in by callers
FNC-1318: backend axis with resolution order, availability check, retains_context, finding location, failure handling, cleanup
FNC-1321/1322: reviewer self-verification and independent evaluator assessment with mechanical linkage of findings
FNC-1305/1306/1311/1314: built-in rule fallback, Issue creation for missing rules, principles severity catalog, document reference viewpoint
Applicability table and open items TBD-1302 to TBD-1304
tasks: Designing or modifying the review skill
Deciding auto-fix behavior for review findings
Handling review CLI flags and argument interpretation
title: REQ-013 レビューポリシー要件
